svg.title: Media Studio target: four views for first-class audio and video
svg.desc: Approved user journey target, not proof of implemented screens. A persistent WPF and Blazor Hybrid shell offers Create, Jobs and Projects plus the selected project and active-job indication. Create accepts a typed or spoken brief and Audio, Video or Both output intent. Contextual authoring reviews a self-contained audio script or video storyboard with typed agent proposals and direct edits. Applying a proposal does not authorize generation. Approve and Generate durably admits the exact saved revision and requested output set before opening Jobs. Jobs observe the existing producer and real per-output outcomes without fake progress. Projects and Artifacts reopen drafts and verified audio/video results without replaying effects; historical submitted inputs are inspected read-only or edited as a new revision.
svg.text: APPROVED UX TARGET / IMPLEMENTATION AND NATIVE VERIFICATION IN PROGRESS
Four views. One durable project. The chosen medium.
Audio and video share authoring context, not a compulsory visual pipeline or identical script.
Persistent shell: Create | Jobs | Projects | Selected project | Active-job indication
Contextual authoring, not another app or an empty global page.
Direct edits + text/voice agent proposals + actual diff
Approve & Generate: exact revision + output set
Bind voice/providers and bounds; admit once before navigation.
Surface unsaved edits, pending proposals and stale conflicts.
Leave view; job is not cancelled
Retry is explicit, never fake resume
One failure is not overall success; keep committed artifacts.
Drafts and running, failed or completed projects; verified direct audio/video playback.
Exact project / revision / attempt / manifest links. Missing, corrupt or intermediate files are not successful output.
Reopen working drafts; inspect submitted snapshots read-only; Edit as new revision without replaying model or generation effects.
Reopen or inspect; do not replay production
Candidate != release. Model downloads, cloud calls, provisioning and publication retain their separate authorization boundaries.
